brief:
Palestine National University has opened admissions and registration for new students beginning the first semester of the 2026-2027 academic year, the Ma'an news agency reported. The university is accepting applications across multiple degree levels, including doctoral and master's programs, bachelor's degrees, and associate diplomas, with offerings spanning diverse specializations.

The institution said it provides scholarships and financial assistance to qualifying students. Palestine National University also highlighted its qualified faculty members, modern facilities, and what it described as an inspiring university environment designed to support academic and intellectual development.
